notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Changes from 1.2.2 to 1.3.0[/h1]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[*]Keyboard garag added to credits screen
[*]Credits streamlined
[*]HUD reference to the pause menu
[*]Control description revised
[*]Nova added to credits again
[*]wwise added to credits and splash image
[*]Enemies and weapons got occlusion outline shaders
[*]Green gates are passable when dissolving
[*]Crates open visually, dissolve and despawn
[*]Chest variants implemented
[*]Enemies hit VFX

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[*]Torc crystal appearance corrected
[*]Green gate appearance corrected and improved
[*]Restart and main menu popup enabled in pause menu
[*]Help menu now closes on ESC
[*]Coin has Echolight Sans Font
[*]Coin has larger trigger range
[*]Chest/Challenge spawn positions improved
[*]Items now always point to the cam
[*]Starting room weapon positions fixed
[*]Honeyfruit gives life and disappears after collecting
[*]Askr has correct mesh with belly crystals
[*]Merchant menu items price texts fixed
[*]Way trails work again
